recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current core specification already implements the published FHIR-15998 resolution in active ValueSet source, and additional prose would be redundant rather than corrective.
issue_request: FHIR-15998 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution asking for syntax on ValueSet.compose.include.version to include all versions of a CodeSystem, using '*' as the special identifier and leaving expansion/version support to server discretion pending implementation experience.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in git-svn commit 3ed2652e3d56764f8a8b1f5024155e6b6840a9e1, matching Jira's svn revision 14124 comment. That commit added the all-versions '*' guidance to ValueSet notes and the then-authoritative ValueSet spreadsheet source; later QA and source-format refactors preserved the semantics in the current XML StructureDefinition and narrative notes.
additional_context: ValueSet remains an active core resource in source/fhir.ini, so the ValueSet StructureDefinition and notes are in current build scope. The Jira-linked Zulip discussion confirms the intended distinction that omitting a version lets the server choose a single version, while '*' explicitly asks for all versions known or supported by the server. No Confluence reference or later community evidence was found that changes the published decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml already defines ValueSet.compose.include.version as the special version '*' for all versions and states that expansion and supported-version behavior are at server discretion. source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml also states that '*' includes codes from all versions of the code system and preserves the implementation-experience warning.
